record.source_closeout_reference: Backlog research spike BACKLOG_RESEARCH_SPIKE_20260611; envelope at docs/Factory/v3/missions/MISSION_V3OP001_20260611_BACKLOG_RESEARCH_SPIKE.md; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Convert the sponsor's reviewed improvement ideas into evidence-first research artifacts that instrument the duration ladder before rung 2: a mission_waypoint shadow-schema candidate, a mission-economics vocabulary, a fresh-worker reentry trial plan, and rung-2-onward friction counters.

forbidden_scope: no validator, fixture, template, schema-file, or skill changes
no new approval or promotion language
no files outside the envelope list
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push at closeout

verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout after all authorized-file edits; results recorded below.

notes: Docs-only research spike with no new dependencies, no executable change, no validators, no schema files, and no anchor rows.
Every new artifact carries research-only and non-enforcing posture language and an explicit statement of what it does not approve.
The spike's sequencing verdicts were sponsor-agreed in-thread (red-team review delivered 2026-06-11) before the envelope was written; the envelope records them as Tier 1 pre-resolved inputs.
No halt or fallback trigger fired; all edits stayed inside the seven authorized files.

friction_notes: The friction counters this spike adds to the ladder plan were themselves designed from accumulated friction notes (MR_008 through MR_021) plus the Phase 3 per-event-telemetry finding; the friction-note corpus is now large enough that a periodic rollup mission classifying notes into actionable, accepted-cost, and retired would convert them from anecdotes into a worklist.
false_positive_notes: None observed in this mission's advisory pass.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Vocabulary-before-schema is now an explicit repeating pattern: mission health (V3-ANCHOR-007) and mission economics both define terms with anti-theater grounding rules and defer schema, lane, and threshold decisions to ladder evidence.

The mission_waypoint candidate's restriction-projection rule (waypoint scope is always a subset of envelope authority and never widens it) keeps the envelope as the sole authority grant while enabling finer-grained drift detection; this division should hold for any future sub-mission structure.

The fresh-worker trial's sealed answer-key protocol converts artifact sufficiency from an asserted property into a falsifiable one; the same brief-before-key pattern could later score any reentry, not just trials.

With no sponsor time pressure, the spike deliberately instruments rung 2 before it runs (waypoint table, friction counters) so the single 2-hour run yields evidence for three open questions at once instead of one.
